info.title: Goho API
info.description: Runs the receipt playbook: upload and track images, and manage finished receipts, the shared book roster and recipes, by hand, from cover scans or from recipe pages. No authentication required, bud.

500.description: Internal Server Error

get.description: Confirms the server is awake; it does not skate over to the database or providers.

413.description: The upload exceeds a size or part-count limit, bud. Nothing is saved or queued.

500.description: The server could not store or queue the receipt image. | Internal Server Error

post.description: Stores one receipt image and returns its queued status before processing starts.

500.description: The server could not pull the uploads off the bench. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Pulls every receipt upload off the bench, newest first, with its current status.

404.description: No receipt upload is wearing that number, bud.

409.description: Only failed uploads can be deleted; this one is queued, processing, or succeeded. Nothing changed.

500.description: The server could not delete this upload and its stored image. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Clears a failed upload and its original image off the bench. Queued, processing, and succeeded uploads return 409; delete the receipt to remove a successful scan.

404.description: No receipt upload is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this receipt upload. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Returns the latest queue or processing status and the receipt ID after a clean finish.

data.description: Complete receipts, newest off the bench first; empty when none exist.

500.description: The server could not pull the receipts off the bench. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Pulls every saved receipt off the bench, newest first, with its items in position order.

500.description: Receipt validation or persistence missed the net. | Internal Server Error

post.description: Creates the receipt and items in one clean play, adding any unfamiliar item category to the roster. Every call saves a new receipt.

404.description: No receipt is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this receipt. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Brings back one saved receipt with its items lined up by position.

404.description: No receipt is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not delete this receipt and its stored image. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Permanently removes the receipt, items, upload record, original image, and extraction data. Returns no body after a clean finish.

404.description: No receipt is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not save this correction; nothing changed. | Internal Server Error

patch.description: Updates the supplied store name or receipt date and returns the complete receipt. Amounts, currency, and items stay on the bench.

404.description: No scanned image is linked to this receipt, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this receipt image. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Returns the scanned image for an uploaded receipt. Manually created receipts may not have one.

404.description: That receipt has no item wearing this number, bud.

500.description: The server could not save this correction; nothing changed. | Internal Server Error

patch.description: Updates the supplied name or category of one existing item and returns just that saved item. An unfamiliar category name joins the roster. Its amount, position, and the rest of the lineup stay put.

schema.description: Text to find in a title or author, ignoring case and extra spaces. Punctuation matches literally; blank lists every book.

data.description: Matching books, newest on the roster first; empty when none match.

500.description: The server could not pull the books off the bench. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Pulls saved books off the bench, newest first. Add `search` to find title or author matches for autocomplete.

500.description: The server could not save this book; nothing changed. | Internal Server Error

post.description: Puts a book on the roster, adding an unfamiliar category too. When a saved book already has that title and author, ignoring case and extra spaces, you get that book back as saved and nothing else changes. A book with no author only matches another with none.

404.description: No book is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this book. | Internal Server Error

404.description: No book is wearing that number, bud.

409.description: Another book on the roster already has that title and author, or that title with no author either. Nothing changed and nothing merged.

500.description: The server could not save this correction; nothing changed. | Internal Server Error

patch.description: Updates the supplied fields and returns the complete book. An unfamiliar category name joins the roster. Matching another book's title and author returns 409; books are never merged.

404.description: No book is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not delete this book and its stored images; take another shot to finish the cleanup. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Takes the book off the roster for good, along with every successful cover scan of it, their images, and extraction data. Its category stays. Returns no body after a clean finish.

404.description: No cover is on file for that book number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this cover image. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Returns the cover scan on file for the book. Books entered by hand have none until a scan of them succeeds.

413.description: The upload exceeds a size or part-count limit, bud. Nothing is saved or queued.

500.description: The server could not store or queue the cover image. | Internal Server Error

post.description: Stores one cover image and returns its queued status before processing starts. A clean scan saves the book, or finds it already on the roster without changing it. No author on the cover? The publisher printed there steps in, and with neither the author stays null.

500.description: The server could not pull the cover scans off the bench. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Pulls every cover scan off the bench, newest first, with its current status.

404.description: No cover scan is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this cover scan. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Returns the latest queue or processing status and the book ID after a clean finish.

404.description: No cover scan is wearing that number, bud.

409.description: Only failed scans can be deleted; this one is queued, processing, or succeeded. Nothing changed.

500.description: The server could not delete this scan and its stored image. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Clears a failed scan and its original image off the bench. Queued, processing, and succeeded scans return 409; delete the book to remove its successful scans.
delete.summary: Delete a failed book cover upload

data.description: Recipe headlines by title A to Z, ignoring case, then newest first; empty when none exist.

500.description: The server could not pull the recipes off the bench. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Pulls every saved recipe's headline details by title, without ingredients, steps or yield. Get a recipe for the full play.

500.description: The server could not save this recipe; nothing changed. | Internal Server Error

post.description: Saves a complete recipe straight to the roster, with no source or photo. Every call saves a new recipe, even with a title already on the roster.

404.description: No recipe is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this recipe. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Brings back one saved recipe with its ingredients, steps and yield.

404.description: No recipe is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not delete this recipe and its photo; take another shot to finish the cleanup. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Takes the recipe off the roster for good, along with every import linked to it and its photo, so its page can be pulled in fresh. Returns no body after a clean finish.

404.description: No photo is on file for that recipe number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this recipe photo. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Returns the JPEG, PNG or WebP photo on file for the recipe. Recipes entered by hand have none until you send one.

201.description: The recipe had no photo; now it does.

204.description: The new photo took the old one's spot on the roster.

404.description: No recipe is wearing that number, bud.

413.description: The upload exceeds a size or part-count limit, bud. Nothing is saved or queued.

500.description: The server could not save this photo; the old one stays put. | Internal Server Error

put.description: Sends one JPEG, PNG or WebP image in the `file` field as the recipe's only photo, replacing any photo it had, imported or sent. The image's own bytes have to show it's one of those types, whatever its file name or MIME type says; anything else returns 400 and the old photo stays. Returns 201 when the recipe had no photo and 204 when it replaced one, both with no body. When two photos drop at once, the last one saved wins.

404.description: No recipe is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not remove this photo; take another shot. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Takes the photo off the recipe for good and leaves the rest of the recipe on the roster. Returns 204 with no body, even when there was no photo to remove.

500.description: The server could not save or queue the import; nothing changed. | Internal Server Error

post.description: Queues a new import of the page and returns 202 before the page is fetched, every time you send it. A page already saved as a recipe, ignoring its fragment, links that recipe without another fetch, and the recipe keeps the URL it was first saved from. After a miss, just send the page again.
post.summary: Import a recipe from a page

500.description: The server could not pull the imports off the bench. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Pulls every recipe import off the bench, newest first, with its current status.

404.description: No recipe import is wearing that number, bud.

500.description: The server could not retrieve this import. | Internal Server Error

get.description: Returns the latest queue or processing status, the recipe ID after a clean finish, and the failure code after a miss.

404.description: No recipe import is wearing that number, bud.

409.description: Only failed imports can be deleted; this one is queued, processing, or succeeded. Nothing changed.

500.description: The server could not delete this import. | Internal Server Error

delete.description: Clears a failed import off the bench. You don't need this to take another shot at the page; just send it again. Queued, processing, and succeeded imports return 409; delete the recipe to remove its successful imports.

RecipeUploadId.description: The recipe import's version 4 UUID; use it to check on this upload.

allOf.description: The page this import pulls from.

status.description: Where the import is in the play: queued, processing, succeeded, or failed.

recipeId.description: The recipe this import saved, once it succeeds.

failureCode.description: Why the import failed, once it fails; details stay in the server logs.

createdAt.description: When the import came off the bench.

updatedAt.description: When the import's status last changed.

RecipeUpload.description: A recipe import and how its processing is going.

RecipeId.description: The recipe's positive number on the roster, from 1 through 9223372036854775807 without leading zeros, bud.

url.description: The http or https page URL as sent, trimmed, up to 2048 UTF-8 bytes and without a username or password, bud; redirects don't change it.

RecipeSource.description: The web page a recipe was pulled from.

CreateRecipeUploadRequest.description: The page to pull a recipe from, bud.

allOf.description: The recipe's roster number; use it to target this recipe.

source.description: Where the recipe was pulled from, or null when it was saved directly.

totalTimeSeconds.description: Total time in seconds, or null when the source doesn't state one.

hasImage.description: Whether a recipe photo is on file.

createdAt.description: When the recipe hit the roster.

ingredients.description: Ingredients in recipe order, each with an ID unique within the recipe.

steps.description: Steps in order; ingredient marks point at this recipe's ingredients.

yield.description: How much the recipe makes, or null when the source doesn't say.

Recipe.description: A saved recipe with its ingredients and steps.

RecipeYield.description: How much the recipe makes, as the source states it.

Quantity.description: How much: an exact fraction, a range with min below max, or the source wording when it isn't a number.

text.description: Source wording for an amount that isn't a number, trimmed.

TextQuantity.description: An amount in the source's words.

RangeQuantity.description: An amount from min up to max.

Fraction.description: An exact positive fraction; 4 is 4/1 and a half is 1/2, bud.

Step.description: One step of the play, in segments.

Segment.description: Plain wording or a mark; join the segments in order to read the step.

MarkSegment.description: A marked part of the step.

MarkContent.description: What a step mark shows: marked wording or part of one ingredient.

ingredientId.description: The ingredient's ID within this recipe; step marks use it to point at the ingredient.

allOf.description: Share of the ingredient's quantity this step uses, up to 1/1 for all of it.

text.description: Marked wording, kept exactly as written, such as an amount that isn't a number.
Plain wording, kept exactly, including leading and trailing spaces.

id.description: The ingredient's ID within this recipe; step marks use it to point at the ingredient.

name.description: Ingredient name with any preparation or package wording, trimmed.

unit.description: Unit for an exact or range quantity; null for a text quantity.

Ingredient.description: One ingredient on the recipe's roster.

RecipeUnit.description: Unit for an exact or range quantity.

ingredients.description: Ingredients in recipe order, each with an ID unique within the recipe.

steps.description: Steps in order; ingredient marks point at this recipe's ingredients.

yield.description: How much the recipe makes, or null when the source doesn't say.

totalTimeSeconds.description: Total time in seconds, or null when the source doesn't state one.

CreateRecipeRequest.description: A full recipe to put on the roster, bud. Leave out the yield or total time, or send null, when it isn't known.

allOf.description: The recipe's roster number; use it to target this recipe.

source.description: Where the recipe was pulled from, or null when it was saved directly.

totalTimeSeconds.description: Total time in seconds, or null when the source doesn't state one.

hasImage.description: Whether a recipe photo is on file.

createdAt.description: When the recipe hit the roster.

BookUploadId.description: The cover scan's version 4 UUID; use it to check on this upload.

fileName.description: File name the scan arrived with.

contentType.description: MIME type of the stored scan.

status.description: Where the scan is in the play: queued, processing, succeeded, or failed.

bookId.description: The book this scan saved or matched, once it succeeds; several scans can land on one book.

failureCode.description: Why the scan failed, once it fails; details stay in the server logs.

createdAt.description: When the scan came off the bench.

updatedAt.description: When the scan's status last changed.

BookUpload.description: A cover scan and how its processing is going.

BookId.description: The book's positive number on the roster, from 1 through 9223372036854775807 without leading zeros, bud.

allOf.description: The book's roster number; use it to target this book.

title.description: Book title, shown as spelled. Case and extra spaces don't make it a different book.

author.description: Author, shown as spelled, or null when nobody knows. The same title by a different author, or without one, is a different book.

allOf.description: The book's category.

readingLevel.description: Reading level as you'd write it, or null when nobody has set one.

hasImage.description: Whether a cover image is on file; the first scan of a book without one adds it.

Book.description: A saved book with its display spelling and category.

allOf.description: The category's roster number.

icon.description: Icon identifier for showing the category. Any string can suit up, so pick a fallback for ones you don't know.

color.description: Stable colour key for showing the category.

kinds.description: Each lineup the category plays for, once. Using a category for receipts or books adds it here.

Category.description: A category on the shared roster. New names suit up with the `other` icon and `grey` colour.

CategoryKind.description: Which lineup a category plays for: receipt items or books.

CategoryId.description: The category's positive number on the roster.

title.description: Book title, shown as spelled. Case and extra spaces don't make it a different book.

author.description: Author to set or replace; cannot be cleared.

category.description: Book category name. It is saved trimmed and lowercase; a name not on the roster yet joins it.

readingLevel.description: Reading level to set or replace; cannot be cleared.

PatchBookRequest.description: Book details to correct, bud. Send at least one field; left-out fields stay put. Values must be nonempty text; null cannot clear them.

title.description: Book title, shown as spelled. Case and extra spaces don't make it a different book.

author.description: Author, shown as spelled, or null when nobody knows. The same title by a different author, or without one, is a different book.

category.description: Book category name. It is saved trimmed and lowercase; a name not on the roster yet joins it.

readingLevel.description: Reading level as you'd write it, or null when nobody has set one.

CreateBookRequest.description: A book to put on the roster. Values are trimmed and stay nonempty; leave out the author or reading level, or send null, when it isn't known.

allOf.description: The item's roster number; use it to target this item.

position.description: Zero-based spot in the receipt lineup.

allOf.description: Item amount; negative adjustments can suit up too.
The item's category.

ReceiptItem.description: A saved receipt line item in its original slot.

DecimalString.description: An exact decimal kept as text so no precision gets lost in the shuffle.

ReceiptItemId.description: The item's positive number on the roster, from 1 through 9223372036854775807 without leading zeros. It sticks with the item through renames.

ReceiptId.description: The receipt's positive number on the roster, from 1 through 9223372036854775807 without leading zeros, bud.

category.description: Item category name. It is saved trimmed and lowercase; a name not on the roster yet joins it.

PatchReceiptItemRequest.description: Line item details to correct. Send a name, a category, or both; left-out fields stay put, and values are trimmed and stay nonempty.

allOf.description: The receipt's roster number, kept the same on a replay.

storeName.description: Store or merchant named on the receipt.

allOf.description: Date the purchase hit the ice.
Amount before tax.
Tax amount.
Final receipt total.

currency.description: Required three-letter currency code for all items and totals, bud. Codes are not checked against a registry.

categories.description: Each distinct item category once, in order of first appearance.

items.description: Items lined up by ascending position.

Receipt.description: A saved receipt with trimmed names and normalized decimals; `11.00` comes back as `11`, beauty.

CalendarDate.description: A real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, from year 0100 through 9999.

storeName.description: Store or merchant named on the receipt.

allOf.description: Date the purchase hit the ice.

PatchReceiptRequest.description: Receipt details to correct, bud. Send at least one field; left-out fields stay put, and names are trimmed and stay nonempty.

storeName.description: Store or merchant named on the receipt.

allOf.description: Date the purchase hit the ice.
Amount before tax.
Tax amount.
Final receipt total.

currency.description: Required three-letter currency code for all items and totals, bud. Codes are not checked against a registry.

CreateReceiptRequest.description: The full receipt lineup, bud. Names are trimmed and stay nonempty; amounts are not rounded, converted, or checked against the totals.

allOf.description: Item amount; negative adjustments can suit up too.

category.description: Item category name. It is saved trimmed and lowercase; a name not on the roster yet joins it.

ReceiptItemInput.description: One receipt line item; repeat names are fair game.

HealthData.description: Whether the server is awake for the shift.
